tasks.gr9-social-environmental-responsibility-: Topic: Social and Environmental Responsibility. Cover community health, social pressure, environmental care, and responsible action. Ask learners to investigate community health issues, analyse how social and environmental conditions affect wellbeing, propose environmental solutions, create community campaign ideas, or reflect on their personal environmental impact.
tasks.gr9-sexuality-health-t2: Topic: Sexuality and Health. Cover puberty, sexual health, HIV and AIDS, consent, and teenage pregnancy. Ask learners to discuss sexual health accurately, challenge myths with facts, explain consent, analyse case studies about relationships, or discuss responsible and respectful choices.
tasks.gr9-substance-abuse-emotional-safety-t2: Topic: Substance Abuse and Emotional Safety. Cover alcohol, drugs, dependence, coping skills, and support services. Ask learners to identify warning signs of substance abuse, explain harmful effects, develop coping strategies, discuss peer pressure and refusal skills, or list support services and resources.
tasks.gr9-physical-education-task-2-t2: Topic: Physical Education Task — Term 2. Cover sport skills, endurance, flexibility, and fair play. Ask learners to develop sport-specific skills, demonstrate endurance activities, complete flexibility assessments, reflect on fair play experiences, or analyse game-play strategies.
